evidence_status: Usable sex-by-BMI mean/SE constraints with assumption-dependent continuous interpolation.
consequence: Category averages do not determine pointwise effects; transporting them can shift means and slopes.
next_action: Stop this one-review pilot with explicit limitation; future work requires compatible aggregate evidence under documented sampling/measurement/adjustment, not target outcome access.
resolution: Correct reported cell means retained. Actual within-cell continuous BMI/age and omitted-covariate distributions remain unavailable; selected pointwise interpolation is still an assumption-dependent bridge.

affected_analysis: Nonlinearity, severe-obesity contrasts and BMI tail analyses
evidence_status: Only an open obesity category and qualitative cross-population monotonic/linear context; severe-BMI slope missing.
consequence: Flat versus continuing decline above BMI 30 can materially alter interpretation at BMI 40-70.
next_action: Stop this one-review pilot with explicit limitation; future work requires compatible aggregate evidence under documented sampling/measurement/adjustment, not target outcome access.
resolution: Retrieved selected Turkish obesity-class means showing a 5.24 mg/dL class-III versus class-I decline. This keeps continuing decline plausible but does not identify target sex-specific decay/asymptotes; selected parameters and the flat-tail sensitivity are retained. Mexican exact sex/class table is unsupported PDF; pooled U.S. lead rejected. No bypass.

affected_analysis: Age association, age-by-sex interaction and older-adult contrasts
evidence_status: Small common adjusted Taiwan age contrasts; Dallas standardized age coefficient differs by sex; compatible raw slope not available.
consequence: Common age effect may understate sex-specific patterns; 20-29 and 71-79 require extrapolation.
next_action: Stop this one-review pilot with explicit limitation; future work requires compatible aggregate evidence under documented sampling/measurement/adjustment, not target outcome access.
resolution: Re-extracted all Taiwan Table 5 age contrasts, p-values and Table 2 age-by-BMI counts. Quantified the difference from pooled contrasts, largest in small underweight stratum. Retained pooled age curve because richer adjustment, unknown covariance/formal interaction and missing sex-specific patterns do not identify a uniquely superior target curve. Additional age fulltext lead rejected; no standardized-to-raw conversion.

affected_analysis: Correlations, subgroup spread, low-HDL prevalence and confidence intervals
evidence_status: Cell SE and n yield total cell SD, not exact residual SD conditional on continuous BMI and age.
consequence: Conditional spread may be overestimated by retained within-cell predictor variance or underestimated by transport differences.
next_action: Stop this one-review pilot with explicit limitation; future work requires compatible aggregate evidence under documented sampling/measurement/adjustment, not target outcome access.
resolution: Cell SD differs from conditional residual SD; adding the age curve also adds between-age variance when marginalizing. Explicit source-midpoint variance accounting performed as a diagnostic, with no invented covariance subtraction. No compatible residual variance/conditional quantile source obtained.

affected_analysis: Threshold prevalence and extreme HDL quantiles
evidence_status: Mean/SE and marginal U.S. IQR do not identify conditional distribution family.
consequence: Lognormal family fixes skew and tail probabilities absent direct evidence.
next_action: Stop this one-review pilot with explicit limitation; future work requires compatible aggregate evidence under documented sampling/measurement/adjustment, not target outcome access.
resolution: Conditional lognormal family retained as a scenario; added studies supply cell means/SDs or inaccessible tables, not conditional tail evidence. Threshold probabilities remain family- and transport-sensitive.

affected_analysis: Every target association and absolute HDL level
evidence_status: Non-U.S. primary anchor; U.S. contextual source excludes several conditions/therapies; source assays incomplete or different.
consequence: Neither source can identify target conditional distribution without transport assumptions.
next_action: Stop this one-review pilot with explicit limitation; future work requires compatible aggregate evidence under documented sampling/measurement/adjustment, not target outcome access.
resolution: New Mexican and Turkish sources have substantial exclusions and different population/measurement conditions. No numerical transport or assay correction is identified. Source heterogeneity remains separate from individual residual variation.

evidence_status: Not the intended cross-sectional virtual-column task.
consequence: Cross-sectional associations cannot be interpreted as treatment or aging responses.
next_action: No causal operator is part of this task.
resolution: No causal or longitudinal claims added; all retained relationships describe a cross-sectional virtual-column scenario.
